def clean(df):
    # Convert Order_ID to numeric
    df['Order_ID'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Order_ID'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert Quantity and Price to numeric
    df['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
    df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix Category label variants
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace('Office Supplies', 'Office Supplies')
    
    # Fix Region label variants
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].replace({'Suoth': 'South', 'Eats': 'East'})
    
    # Fix invalid dates
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Remove rows with invalid dates
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Date'])
    
    # Convert Date to YYYY-MM format
    df['Year-Month'] = df['Date'].dt.to_period('M')
    
    # Keep only necessary columns
    df = df[['Order_ID', 'Year-Month', 'Revenue']]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by Year-Month and sum Revenue
    result = df.groupby('Year-Month')['Revenue'].sum()
    
    # Convert to dictionary with string keys
    return {str(month): float(revenue) for month, revenue in result.items()}
